scope: Separate P4 and P8 physical runs of identical guarded workloads; T32, serial schedule, 100 MHz and 115200 baud

controls.precision: signed INT8 inputs / signed INT32 outputs

workload_identity_scope: Descriptors and guarded input/sentinel images reconstructed from the identical sealed host sources and pinned matrix bytes; not a captured AXI address trace
measurement_semantics: Job cycles include all DDR job traffic through final B; active compute and input-wait counters are separate observations. Stall counters are not complete phase durations and are not summed into job time.
pairing_semantics: Dense records paired by ordinal repetition for presentation; runs were sequential by image, not interleaved or simultaneous. Actual DDR timing variations remain in the distributions.
